description: Natural-language intents for the tool-selection eval. 'expected' lists every tool a myceliums maintainer would accept as the first call, primary choice first; the first entry is used as the row label in the confusion table. Written against the live tools/list of myc 0.3.2 (54 tools). Phrasings deliberately avoid copying the tool descriptions where a developer would not use those words.
